title: 第536章 七盏面具，林远知道是什么了！
slug: 规则怪谈从诡异哆啦a梦开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

七盏面具。

让林远一边安抚着红太狼，一边回忆起原作。

他并没有想到原作中出现过这些面具。

可为什么，这些生物会突然出现在喜羊羊与灰太狼的怪谈游戏中？

熊出没怪谈游戏中，天才威研制出极恶贝利亚，已经够让他吃惊了。

难不成，又是其余动漫中的诡异？

可天才威能研制出极恶贝利亚，是因为他曾在原作中研制出过实验怪兽。

失败之后寻找超越上一个的设定，倒也能说过去。

谁让怪谈游戏从来都不讲武德？

如果不是有赵琳的相机在，以极恶贝利亚的实力，林远就只能等死了。

林远又想到了在哆啦A梦怪谈游戏中，单元剧与剧场版的设定。

可喜羊羊与灰太狼的剧场版，貌似有十几部吧？

似乎因为林远拍打后背很温柔，红太狼竟在林远怀中睡着了。

她轻轻的呼吸声，让林远回过了身。

林远慢慢的将红太狼放倒在床上，为她盖好了被子。

他原本还想问问红太狼之前欲言又止时，说的就算后面是什么，但见此情形，只能等明天再问了。

林远躺在另一侧，继续思索起来。

可无论他怎么想，都想不到原作中曾出现过这样的生物，又或是带着如此面具的怪人。

劳累了一天，林远也发出了均匀的呼吸声，

他睡着了。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Seven masks.

Let Lin Yuan comfort Red Wolf while recalling the original work.

He didn't expect these masks to appear in the original work.

But why do these creatures suddenly appear in the game Pleasant Goat and Big Big Wolf?

In the game "The Haunted Bear", Genius Wei developed the extremely evil Belial, which was enough to surprise him.

Could it be that it's weird like other anime?

But Genius Wei was able to develop the Evil Belial because he had developed an experimental monster in the original work.

After failure, it is okay to look for a setting that surpasses the previous one.

Who told Kaitan Games to never talk about martial ethics?

If it weren't for Zhao Lin's camera, Lin Yuan would have had no choice but to wait for death with Beria's strength.

Lin Yuan once again thought about the settings of unit drama and theater version in the Doraemon Monster Game.

There seem to be more than a dozen theatrical versions of Pleasant Goat and Big Big Wolf, right?

It seemed that because Lin Yuan's pat on the back was so gentle, Red Wolf actually fell asleep in Lin Yuan's arms.

Her gentle breathing made Lin Yuan turn around.

Lin Yuan slowly laid Red Wolf down on the bed and covered her with a quilt.

He originally wanted to ask the red wolf what was behind what he said when he hesitated, but seeing this situation, he could only wait until tomorrow to ask.

Lin Yuan lay on the other side and continued to think.

But no matter what he thought, he never imagined that such a creature or a weirdo with such a mask had ever appeared in the original work.

After a tiring day, Lin Yuan also breathed evenly,

He fell asleep.
